identity.description: The personal workstation of 申杰 / j3w1 — writer and software engineer building governed execution tooling, business platforms, developer environments, and design systems.

readme: I build calm, dependable software for real work: governed execution tooling, business platforms, developer environments, and design systems — with clear contracts, useful evidence, and foundations meant to last.
Building now: pod, CE Systems, and CE Metadata. Public work: theme, j3w1zsh, and this site.

paragraphs: I work on software that has to survive contact with real organizations: business systems, operational workflows, and the tools engineers use to build and maintain them.

My interests connect software architecture with writing and developer environments. I care about clear contracts, recoverable workflows, evidence that can be checked, and systems that remain understandable after the original implementation context is gone.

Current work includes [pod](https://github.com/j3w1/pod), which turns an Orca coding session into the coordinator of a pod of agents; CE Systems, Casa Elida's modular enterprise platform; CE Governed Delivery, a credential-isolated controller for governed review, merge, and delivery; and CE Metadata, a deterministic control plane for GitHub metadata.

Public work includes [theme](https://github.com/j3w1/theme), the canonical j3w1 design system this site is dressed in; [j3w1zsh](https://github.com/j3w1/j3w1zsh), a portable, resumable workstation framework for Arch Linux, Arch WSL 2, and Termux; [ce-signage](https://github.com/j3w1/ce-signage), digital signage for Casa Elida's cashier PCs; [1688toCSV](https://github.com/j3w1/1688toCSV), a focused browser extension for order-data export; and [the source for this site](https://github.com/j3w1/j3w1.github.io).

entries.name: pod
entries.summary: Turns the Codex or Claude Code session already open in Orca into the coordinator of a pod of agents: it plans the objective, chooses direct work or workers in isolated worktrees, and binds every result to its evidence.

entries.name: CE Systems
entries.summary: Casa Elida's modular enterprise platform for retail, inventory, purchasing, logistics, finance, people operations, ecommerce, and reporting.

entries.name: CE Governed Delivery
entries.summary: A credential-isolated controller for governed CE Systems review, correction, merge, and delivery reconciliation, keeping AI assistance bounded and human decision points dependable.
facts: Governed review · Bounded merge · Delivery reconciliation

entries.name: CE Metadata
entries.summary: A deterministic control plane for GitHub metadata, with reviewable plans, bounded writes, and exact readback.
facts: Reviewable plans · Bounded writes · Exact readback

entries.name: theme
entries.summary: The canonical j3w1 design system: tokens, components, accessibility rules, ports, and machine-readable exports. This site consumes its approved default profile as a pinned CSS-variable export.

entries.name: j3w1zsh
entries.summary: A portable, resumable Zsh workstation framework for native Arch Linux, Arch WSL 2, and Termux, with presets, themes, project workspaces, migration, and remote-session support.
facts: Shell · Zsh · Arch Linux · WSL · Termux

entries.name: j3w1.github.io
entries.summary: The dependency-free source for this site: a working i3 window manager in the browser, published verbatim by GitHub Pages.

entries.name: ce-signage
entries.summary: Digital signage for Casa Elida's Windows 10 cashier PCs: cashiers drop images and videos into a folder, and a controller validates them with FFmpeg, rebuilds a randomized playlist, and plays it fullscreen on the second monitor.

entries.name: 1688toCSV
entries.summary: A compact Chrome extension that exports 1688.com order details into a clean CSV for practical downstream use.

entries.name: 1w3j
entries.summary: An earlier generation of personal Linux workstation configuration, scripts, themes, package lists, and bootstrap tooling. j3w1zsh is the current public workstation framework, and this site's desktop is its reinterpretation.

entries.name: CE Desktop
entries.summary: An earlier JavaFX prototype for a Material Design Casa Elida enterprise desktop application, preserved as part of the public project history.
